description: This file defines the RegexStreamNamespacePredicate class implementing IStreamNamespacePredicate, enabling namespace filtering via regular expressions within the Orleans.Streams namespace.

classes.name: RegexStreamNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Implements IStreamNamespacePredicate to filter stream namespaces using regex patterns.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Property returning the regex pattern with prefix for identifying the predicate.

methods.name: RegexStreamNamespacePredicate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the regex from the provided pattern with RegexOptions.Compiled.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the provided stream namespace matches the regex pattern.
